performance.verdict: Meta delivering leads; Google burning $2,016 for 1 conversion—SOW unlaunched.

findings.text: 6 SOW milestones overdue since July 31–Aug 1: Pre-Launch Stack Test, LSA Verification, Site/Landing Pages, Ads Launch, Meta Retargeting, and Shoot 1 (due Sep 30) all show no completed event.
Google Ads spent $2,016.20 in 28 days for 1 conversion; 3-day spend Oct 26–28 ($150.66 total) still live with zero leads confirmed—cost-per-result is effectively unbounded.
Meta CPL collapsed 58.64% week-over-week; 35 leads on $1,818.39 (28-day) at $51.95 CPL—3-day lead total Oct 26–28 is 3 leads on ~$234.72 spend, trend holding.
GHL shows 105 opportunities created but 0 won and 0 appointments in 28 days; 35 Meta leads arriving but pipeline converting to nothing—intake process is the leak, not ad volume.
GBP actions dropped 65.12% week-over-week; last 3 days (Oct 26–28) show 1, 0, 0 actions—organic search presence deteriorating while paid traffic is active.

suggestions.text: Escalate all 6 overdue SOW milestones to Nacer immediately; LSA cannot launch without verification submitted.
suggestions.monday_update: Six SOW milestones are confirmed overdue, the earliest dating to 2026-07-31 (Pre-Launch Stack Test, LSA Verification, Site & Landing Pages, Ads Launch, Meta Retargeting, Shoot 1). Nacer must confirm current status on each item and unblock LSA verification as the critical path dependency for Google Ads launch. Success check: all 6 items have an owner, status, and revised completion date logged in Monday by 2026-11-01. Sohib to confirm with client that intake coverage is confirmed before any ad scale.

suggestions.text: Pause Google Ads Search Campaign; $2,016.20 spent for 1 conversion in 28 days with no improving 3-day signal.
suggestions.monday_update: Google Ads has spent $2,016.20 over 28 days and produced 1 reported conversion; the 3-day window (Oct 26–28) shows continued spend with zero leads confirmed. This is confirmed spend with no measurable return. Pause the Leads - Search Campaign immediately and hold budget until LSA verification is live and conversion tracking is independently verified end-to-end per the SOW. Resume only after the pre-launch stack test (F1) is passed. Sohib to approve before any pause is executed.

suggestions.text: Fix GHL intake: 105 opportunities, 0 appointments, 0 won—speed-to-lead and routing per SOW are not firing.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 105 opportunities created with 0 appointments booked and 0 cases won in the 28-day window, confirming leads are arriving but not being worked. The SOW requires first contact under 5 minutes, instant routing by source/case type, and a missed-call-text-back cadence—none of these are evidenced in the pipeline data. Nacer to audit GHL routing rules, assignment triggers, and auto-reply sequences this week. Success check: at least 1 appointment booked and confirmed in GHL within 7 days of fix deployment; re-check 2026-11-05.
